explanation: I found no Mathlib lemma with this content. The statement computes the component of `SheafedSpace.ofRestrict` at the open `U` itself, written as a pair of `eqToHom` casts. One of these casts comes from the library's own lemma `restrict_Γ_obj`. Mathlib only has the general simps lemma `PresheafedSpace.ofRestrict_c_app` (the component at any open, in terms of the adjunction counit) and the special case `PresheafedSpace.ofRestrict_top_c` for the embedding of the whole space `⊤`. Neither states this result. The library's proof rewrites with the SheafedSpace version of `ofRestrict_c_app` and with `Opens.adjunction_counit_app_self`, then rearranges the `eqToHom`s. That is a short computation combining two lemmas with the library's own cast, not a single Mathlib statement. I grepped Mathlib for `ofRestrict.*_c_app`, `ofRestrict_top_c` and related restriction-of-sections lemmas, and read the matches in `Mathlib/Geometry/RingedSpace/PresheafedSpace.lean` and `Mathlib/Geometry/RingedSpace/OpenImmersion.lean`.
